description: This file contains unit tests for the ResourceOptimizedPlacementOptions class, validating its default values, constants, and input validation logic for resource weights configuration in the Orleans framework.

classes.name: ResourceOptimizedPlacementOptionsTests
classes.description: Test class for resource optimized placement configuration options validation, using Xunit framework.

methods.name: ConstantsShouldNotChange
methods.description: Verifies that the default constants for resource weights are unchanged.

methods.name: DefaultShouldEqualConstants
methods.description: Checks that the default property values in ResourceOptimizedPlacementOptions match the default constants.

methods.name: InvalidWeightsShouldThrow
methods.description: Ensures that invalid negative or out-of-range weights throw OrleansConfigurationException.

methods.name: ValidWeightsShouldNotThrow
methods.description: Verifies that valid resource weight values do not throw exceptions during validation.
